core_obligations: Formalize sequential head access, full state space and interval markings.
Retain the complete marking-frequency and interval-coverage bounds.
Show good restrictions force close codewords by the author state-tuple argument.
Prove good restrictions exist by random-input/interval averaging and derive the main time-space-head bound.
difficulty_reason: The authors develop an interval-marking method that distinguishes repeatedly crossing a boundary from revisiting an interval after all heads have left. Adaptive encoders are handled by random restrictions and state-tuple collisions. The resulting sequential-access time-space-head lower bound is a nonroutine information argument; all supporting local proofs remain uncounted.
